summary: Frontend-only regression test for the cms-v35-interactive-tour drop-in App.js. 31/33 checks passed. Both guided tours (dashboard, editor) work perfectly when triggered manually via the ▶ Tour button, Help modal replay, keyboard arrows, Back/Next/Skip/Esc/Finish and progress dots — however BOTH tours FAIL to auto-launch on first visit due to a React.StrictMode double-invocation bug in the useEffect that schedules the setTimeout. All regression-critical features are intact: Colours & Fonts theme panel (4 presets, accent, fonts, live preview, Save/Reset), + Add section picker (inserts + Undo works), Find & Replace opens, footer shows cms-v35 stamp on both UI and API, and admin login goes straight to dashboard (no forced-pw regression). Theme was reset and inserted section undone at the end so wifetobe is left clean.

ui_bugs.issue: Neither tour auto-launches on first visit even after localStorage is cleared. Root cause: the useEffect at App.js:1631-1637 (dashboard) and App.js:1943-1949 (editor) sets `tourAutoStarted.current = true` synchronously and schedules a 450ms/650ms setTimeout, with a cleanup that clears the timer. Under React.StrictMode (index.js:18) the effect runs twice in dev — first run sets ref=true + timer, cleanup clears the timer, second run sees ref already true and bails. Net result: setShowTour(true) never fires. The manual ▶ Tour button and Help replay both work because they call setShowTour(true) directly. Fix: set `tourAutoStarted.current = true` INSIDE the setTimeout callback (right before setShowTour(true)), or remove the ref guard, or move the storageHas check into a separate mount-only effect.

action_items: Fix auto-launch of BOTH dashboard and editor tours (App.js lines ~1631-1637 and ~1943-1949). The current useEffect sets the ref BEFORE the timer callback, so under React.StrictMode dev double-invocation the cleanup clears the timer and the second invocation bails out. Recommended fix: move `tourAutoStarted.current = true` inside the setTimeout callback (right before setShowTour(true)) so the guard only trips after the tour actually opens. Manual ▶ Tour button and Help replay work fine — this only affects first-visit auto-launch.

rca_of_the_issue: React.StrictMode (index.js:18) causes dev-mode useEffect to run twice. In App.js:1631 the effect assigns `tourAutoStarted.current = true` synchronously and only THEN schedules the setTimeout. Cleanup on the first run clears that timer. Second run sees ref=true and returns early. Reproduction: clear all localStorage 'tour_*' keys, refresh dashboard or open editor, wait 6s — [data-testid="guided-tour"] never appears. Confirmed empty localStorage at the moment the check would run. Fix pattern: `const timer = window.setTimeout(() => { tourAutoStarted.current = true; setShowTour(true); }, 450);` — this way the cleanup on the first effect run clears the pending timer AND the ref is still false, so the second run reschedules successfully.
